parts.title: Reading (Lezen)
parts.text: Short Dutch texts like letters, notices and ads, with questions.

parts.title: Listening (Luisteren)
parts.text: Short Dutch conversations with audio and questions.

parts.title: KNM
parts.text: Knowledge of Dutch society: work, health, housing, school and the government.

parts.title: Writing (Schrijven)
parts.text: Write short messages and fill in forms. Optional feedback from Claude with your own API key.

parts.title: Practice exams
parts.text: Timed mock exams that work like the real exam, with your score at the end.

parts.title: Speaking (Spreken): not yet
parts.text: Speaking is not in the app yet. Use DUO's free official practice exams for it.

why.title: Free, no account
why.text: No paywall and no sign-up. Your progress stays on your own device.

why.title: Works offline
why.text: Add it to your home screen and practise on the train.

why.title: Made for A2
why.text: Lessons, words and exercises at the level of the A2 exam.

faq.q: Is this the official inburgering exam?
faq.a: No. Train for Inburgering is not part of DUO. You take the real exam at a DUO exam location. DUO also has free [official practice exams](https://www.inburgeren.nl/en/taking-the-integration-exam/practicing.jsp): try those too, so you know the real exam screens.
Yes. There is no account, no paywall and no advertising. Only the optional writing feedback from Claude uses your own Anthropic API key, which Anthropic charges you for.

faq.q: Which parts of the exam can I practise?
faq.a: Reading, Listening, Writing and KNM (knowledge of Dutch society), plus timed practice exams. Speaking is not in the app yet.
The buttons and explanations are in English, Dutch or Spanish, as you choose. The exercises are in Dutch, like the real exam.

faq.q: Do I need the A2 exam or B1?
faq.a: [Mijn Inburgering](/guides/mijn-inburgering-login/) shows which exams you have to take and at which level. Under the 2021 law, your PIP (the integration plan you made with your municipality) says it too. This course is for A2.

faq.q: Does it work on my phone?
faq.a: Yes. Open it in your phone's browser and add it to your home screen. After the first visit it also works without internet.

landing.disclaimer: Train for Inburgering is not part of DUO or the Dutch government. All texts and questions are our own. A practice score here does not guarantee your real exam result.

guide.unofficial: This is an unofficial guide. DUO can change its process at any time; the official information is on inburgeren.nl.
